headline: Gale warning over for Florida's east coast
dateline: Ended 2am Wed Oct 28 · Fernandina Beach to Biscayne Bay
what: The gale warning that ran since Oct 24 has ended. No gale, storm or tropical warnings are up today for any Gulf or Florida coastal waters.
why: Small craft advisories still run into Thursday and Friday in places, and coastal flood warnings are up along parts of the coast.
todo: Check your zone's marine forecast before heading out – and with high water, check bridge clearance boards.

headline: Hiram's Haul: beach cats race the Indian River
what: The 28th Hiram's Haul sends beach cats and small multihulls (14–22 ft) 30 miles south down the Indian River on Saturday and back on Sunday.
why: Fast catamarans on the Atlantic ICW all Halloween weekend, with a costume party at Capt. Hiram's Sand Bar on Saturday night.
todo: Give the fleet room on the ICW. Start is POW/MIA Park just north of the Pineda Causeway. Info: 407-473-4180.
